title: Checking Arm-Tape Colors for Toddler Health
title_te: పిల్లల ఆరోగ్యం కోసం చేతి టేపు రంగులు తెలుసుకోవడం
problem: The Anganwadi sister measures small babies' arms with colored tapes to check their growth, but mothers sometimes misunderstand what red or yellow colors mean.
idea: A MUAC tape helper. The camera sees which colour the tape shows on the baby's arm and gives simple advice for the mother. Here you can tap the colour.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What colour does the arm tape show?
widgets.intro: The MUAC tape is used for children aged 6 months to 5 years. In my real project, Teachable Machine learns tape photos. Here, tap a colour.
widgets.question: The tape around the baby's upper arm shows:

options.label: GREEN
options.result: Green means the child's growth looks fine. Keep giving good food and go for monthly check-ups.
options.te: ఆకుపచ్చ అంటే పెరుగుదల బాగుంది. మంచి ఆహారం ఇస్తూ, ప్రతి నెల చెకప్‌కి వెళ్ళండి.

options.label: YELLOW
options.result: Yellow means the child is a little weak. Follow the Anganwadi sister's food advice and check again soon.
options.te: పసుపు అంటే పిల్లలు కొంచెం బలహీనంగా ఉన్నారు. అంగన్‌వాడీ అక్క చెప్పిన ఆహారం ఇవ్వండి.

options.label: RED
options.result: Red means the child is very weak. Go to the doctor or health centre right away for special care.
options.te: ఎరుపు అంటే పిల్లలు చాలా బలహీనంగా ఉన్నారు. వెంటనే డాక్టర్ దగ్గరికి వెళ్ళండి.
options.tip: Red is serious but can be treated. The doctor and Anganwadi will help.

questions.q: Where on the body is the MUAC tape put?
questions.why: It goes around the middle of the upper arm, usually the left arm.

questions.q: The tape shows RED. What should the mother do?
options: Go to the doctor or health centre right away
questions.why: Red needs quick care. Early help makes children strong again.

questions.q: Which food helps a child grow strong?
options: Dal, eggs, milk, green leaves and Anganwadi food
questions.why: Home food with dal, eggs, milk, vegetables and Anganwadi meals helps growth.

questions.q: Who can explain the tape result?
questions.why: Always ask the Anganwadi teacher or ASHA if you don't understand.

how: Ask the Anganwadi teacher to show you a MUAC tape (only use photos of the tape, not of babies without permission).
Take about 40 photos each of the tape showing green, yellow and red.
Open Teachable Machine, make 3 classes (Green, Yellow, Red), Train and Export.
In PictoBlox, load the model and show a simple advice card for each colour.
Ask Gemini to write the advice in simple Telugu, and check it with the Anganwadi teacher.
Show the helper at the next Anganwadi mothers' meeting.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain in simple Telugu and English what green, yellow and red mean on a MUAC arm tape for children aged 6 months to 5 years, with one kind line of advice for the mother for each colour. Tell them to follow the Anganwadi worker and doctor.
